name: Heshan
source: Official Heshan government material identifies the Heshan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau (鹤山市自然资源局) as the local custodian for natural-resource and real-estate-rights registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying, registration information management, and public access guidance. No anonymous public Heshan parcel feature service or downloadable citywide parcel layer was qualified.

queries.query: Heshan China official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: Discovery found the official Heshan Natural Resources Bureau organization/functions page, the official Heshan government information-disclosure portal, the Guangdong Tianditu public geographic-information platform, and an indexed Heshan official parcel-map notice. No public Heshan parcel viewer, anonymous parcel API, or downloadable citywide parcel layer was identified.

queries.query: 鹤山市 自然资源局 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地 GIS 官方
queries.result: 官方检索确认鹤山市自然资源局负责自然资源和不动产统一确权登记、权籍调查、不动产测绘、登记信息平台与数据库建设、社会查询指导等工作；同时找到广东省地理信息公共服务平台。未发现可匿名访问的鹤山市宗地要素服务、地籍图接口或返回安全宗地标识与几何的公开请求。

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: 鹤山市自然资源局 / Heshan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official 2026 organization/functions page identifies cadastral surveying, geographic-information management, unified natural-resource and real-estate-rights registration, cadastral investigation, registration database/platform work, and guidance for public registration-information queries. This establishes local custodial responsibility, not an open parcel API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: 鹤山市不动产登记中心 / Heshan Real Estate Registration Center
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official Heshan government budget document identifies the local real-estate registration center and its duties for registration-material queries and cadastral/right-registration survey results. It does not expose a public parcel geometry endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guangdong Provincial Geographic Information Public Service Platform / Guangdong Natural Resources technical center
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Guangdong province; general public geographic-information services
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current public portal and map.js expose general vector/imagery/terrain WMTS map infrastructure and catalog links. The inspected public configuration did not expose a Heshan cadastral or parcel feature layer.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: One published Heshan parcel-map notice, not citywide coverage
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Search indexed a parcel-map publication with a native parcel number and coordinate table, but the direct URL returned HTTP 404 during this attempt; no geometry was retained or treated as a live parcel service.
